sheet.importHint: The ship is replaced with the file's data: compartments, stats, crew. Scene, log and permissions stay. Rebuild the scene afterwards.

melee.label: Melee
melee.effect: Disadvantage on hits for all guns. Turbulence

far.label: Far
far.effect: Hit penalty for close-range guns. Evasive manoeuvres are more effective

params.stale: The ship layout changed — the scene is outdated, press “Rebuild”.

builder.dragHint: Drag a compartment from the catalog, a compendium or the Items tab onto the grid; placed compartments can be moved.

catalog.newHint: Create a custom compartment in the “SkyPlane” item folder
catalog.editCopy: Edit (a world copy is created and replaces this entry in the catalog)
catalog.deleteConfirm: Delete “{name}” from the catalog? Compartments already placed on ships stay.
catalog.copied: “{name}” copied to the world — edit the copy.
catalog.syncHint: Placed copies of this compartment get its properties. Position, passages and damage taken are kept.
catalog.syncKeptSize: The new size did not fit, the old one was kept: {names}.
catalog.pickHint: Compartment catalog: the module's compendiums and your own catalogs from the “SkyPlane Combat Re:verse” folder.
catalog.createHint: New catalog — your own compendium in the “SkyPlane Combat Re:verse” folder; its compartments are edited right there
catalog.name: Catalog name
catalog.created: Catalog “{name}” created in compendiums, folder “SkyPlane Combat Re:verse”.
catalog.newInCatalogHint: Create a compartment in this catalog
catalog.syncKeptInventory: Inventory grid not reduced — the contents do not fit: {names}.

crew.dropHint: Drop an actor here to add it to the crew.

log.clearConfirm: Delete all log entries of this ship?

scene.revealed: The ship was revealed by enemy recon (“{scene}”).
scene.revealedManual: The GM revealed the ship to the enemy (“{scene}”).

combat.undone: The GM undid the hit by “{attacker}” with “{weapon}” on “{target}”.

combat.alreadyFired: This gun has already fired this round.
combat.notWeapon: There is no gun in this compartment.
combat.weaponDestroyed: The gun is destroyed and cannot fire.
combat.noShooter: None of your tokens is in this compartment.
combat.notYourTurn: You can only fire on your turn.
combat.pickTarget: Pick a compartment of the enemy ship. Right click or Esc cancels.
combat.pickEnemy: Only a compartment of the enemy ship can be targeted.
combat.notRecon: This is not an intact recon compartment.
combat.noScout: None of your crew tokens is in this recon compartment.
combat.scoutHiddenByGm: Scouting succeeded, but the GM is hiding the enemy for now.
combat.scoutSuccess: Scouting succeeded: the enemy is revealed while the scout stays at the post.
combat.pendingNotice: Hit on “{target}”: {amount} damage — waiting for the GM.
combat.charging: The gun is charging — it fires next round.
combat.chargedNotice: “{weapon}” is charged — it fires from the next round.
combat.pickVolleyTarget: Volley, shot {index} of {count}: pick an enemy compartment. Right click or Esc ends the volley.
combat.noAmmo: Out of ammo: the GM reloads it in the compartment window.

itemSheet.combatHint: A gun is a compartment with firepower (more than 0 damage dice). For recon compartments the skill and DC are the scouting check.
itemSheet.inventoryHint: Inventory cells of the compartment; 0 means no inventory. Players open it while their token stands in the compartment.

compartment.title: Compartment
compartment.missing: This compartment is no longer on the ship.

repair.title: Repair: {name}
repair.hint: Compartment HP {value}/{max}. One consumable is spent.
repair.none: Your crew characters have no repair consumables.

battle.noBattle: View a battle scene to manage the ships.
battle.autoHint: Clear the GM decision: reveal follows scouting again
battle.dragHint: To move a token to the other ship, enable Unconstrained Movement in the token tools: in v13 walls stop the GM too.
battle.fireAsCrew: Fire for the crew: the token in the gun shoots, otherwise the captain or the ship's crew
battle.endHint: The tracker combat ends, the result goes to the chat and the ship logs, and the players return to their ship's scene.

params.label: Edit parameters
params.hint: Name, class, image, captain, numbers on the Parameters tab, description

build.label: Build the ship
build.hint: Builder: add, move, remove compartments, map size, starter kit

repair.label: Repair
repair.hint: The “Repair…” and “Extinguish” buttons in the compartment window

combat.label: Fight
combat.hint: Firing guns and scouting on your own ship in a battle scene

phlogiston.label: Phlogiston and distance
phlogiston.hint: Clicks on the phlogiston scale and distance plates

permissions.noPlayers: There are no players in this world.
permissions.gmOnlyNote: A right applies only to ships whose crew includes the player's character. Deploying and rebuilding scenes, battles, crew, damage, passages, reveal and the log are GM only.

permissions.name: Crew permissions
permissions.label: Open the permission matrix
permissions.hint: Which ship actions each player may perform.

rangePenalty.name: Gun range penalty
rangePenalty.hint: How much the hit DC grows when the current range is not among the gun's ranges without penalty.

animations.name: Interface animations
animations.hint: Smooth transitions and highlights in module windows.

gmConfirmsDamage.name: GM applies damage
gmConfirmsDamage.hint: A hit does not remove HP right away: a chat card appears and the GM applies or rejects the damage with a button. Unchecked, damage applies at once and the GM can undo it from the card.

rebuild.title: Rebuild scene
rebuild.warning: Ship tiles, regions and walls will be recreated; manual edits to generated objects will be lost. Tokens and manually added objects stay.

rules.outOfBounds: The compartment is outside the ship map ({width}×{height}).
rules.outsideOnly: “Outside only”: “{name}” would have no free neighbouring square.
rules.noEngine: There is no Engine room compartment.
rules.notAdjacent: “{name}” does not share a side with any other compartment.
rules.resizeBlocked: Cannot shrink the map: “{name}” would be outside.

notify.denied: You have no right to do this on this ship.
notify.noGm: Only a connected GM can perform this action.
notify.gmOnly: Only the GM can do this.
notify.captainNotInCrew: The captain must be a crew member.
notify.notCompartment: This is not a skyship compartment.
notify.kitMissing: The catalog lacks stairs, a hold or a cabin.
notify.notRepairItem: This is not a repair consumable.
notify.notYourItem: The consumable must belong to your crew character.
notify.actionFailed: The action failed, see the GM console.
notify.notModuleScene: This scene was not built by the module.
notify.deployWithErrors: The ship layout has errors — the scene is built anyway.
notify.noOtherShips: There is no other ship to fight.
notify.notShipJson: This is not a SkyPlane ship JSON.
notify.crewDropped: These actors are not in this world and were removed from the crew: {count}.

setup.exampleDescription: A training skyship built from the compartment catalog. Deploy it, add a crew and try the builder.
setup.done: SkyPlane Combat Re:verse is set up: the example ship “Albatross”, its scene and macros in the “SkyPlane” folder.
setup.failed: SkyPlane first run did not finish, see the console.

card.title: Hit: {amount} damage
card.splash: Splash: neighbouring compartments take {amount} damage each.

specialHint.splash: Compartments sharing a side with the target take half the damage — to their own HP only, not to the ship's hull.
specialHint.charge: The first press charges the gun and uses its shot this round; it can fire from the next round.
specialHint.volley: Each damage die is a separate shot: its own target, its own hit check and one damage die.

undo.name: Undo in the builder
undo.hint: Undoes the last placement, move or removal in the open ship builder.

rotate.name: Rotate inventory item
rotate.hint: While an item is being dragged on a compartment inventory grid.

effects.title: Active effects
effects.hint: A ship counts a compartment's effects while it is intact and “Effect enabled” is on. Keys and modes are in the “Active effects” help page. Placed compartments get edits via “Update on ships”.

burning.label: Burning
burning.hint: At the start of each combat round the compartment takes 1d6 damage; checks in it have disadvantage. Put it out with “Extinguish” (Athletics, DC 12).
burning.noCrew: Your token must stand in this compartment to fight the fire.

breach.label: Breach
breach.hint: Difficult terrain and −1 to the ship's speed. Closed by repairing the compartment with a consumable, or by the GM.

smoke.label: Smoke
smoke.hint: Checks in the compartment have disadvantage. Clears at the start of the next combat round.

ammo.label: Ammo
ammo.maxHint: Shots before a reload; 0 means unlimited. A volley uses one charge.

ammoItem.label: Ammunition
ammoItem.drop: Drop an item here — without one the gun uses no ammunition
ammoItem.hint: The gun uses such items from its compartment's inventory: same source as the dropped item.

inventory.notPresent: Stand in this compartment with your token.
inventory.magazineFull: The gun is already fully loaded.
inventory.title: Inventory: {compartment} — {ship}
inventory.readOnly: View only: stand in the compartment with your token to take and store items.
inventory.hint: Drag an item from a character sheet onto the grid. While dragging, F rotates the item; right-click opens the menu.
inventory.onlyFromCharacter: You can store items from your character sheet.
inventory.noReceiver: Nobody to receive it: no token of yours in the compartment and no assigned character.
inventory.removeConfirm: “{name}” holds {count} item stacks. They will be lost with the compartment (Ctrl+Z restores everything).
inventory.undoBlocked: Undo would remove “{name}” with its items. Take the items out first or remove the compartment with its button.
inventory.actorNotPresent: “{name}” is not standing in this compartment.
